l2Support: Minority-language learners taught in the mother tongue must study a bilingual programme
That programme runs under art 13.1.4 of the Law on the Mongolian Language
The government member in charge of education approves the bilingual programme
It applies where national-minority learners with another language are the majority
Deaf learners take general education in written and in Mongolian sign language instead

evidence.quote: СУРАЛЦАГЧИЙН ДИЙЛЭНХ ОЛОНХ НЬ ХҮН АМЫН ӨӨР ХЭЛ БҮХИЙ ҮНДЭСТНИЙ ЦӨӨНХИЙН СУРАЛЦАГЧ БАЙХ ТОХИОЛДОЛД
